sections.heading: 50/30/20 rule
sections.body: Allocate 50% to needs (rent, utilities, food, transport), 30% to wants (subscriptions, discretionary), and 20% to savings and debt paydown. Adjust for PH context: if you're a breadwinner, needs may be higher; aim to keep at least 10–20% for savings.

sections.heading: Track first
sections.body: Before cutting, track spending for a month. Use a spreadsheet or app. Then set limits per category and automate savings (e.g., automatic transfer on payday) so you save before spending.
